qualification: N10.3 diagnostic only. One-variable contrast against n10_horizon2_speed031_calibration.json; the 0.32m/s/axis planner candidate is derived from the #343 final spline control-point derivative and 5% feasibility tolerance. This is not a physical or acceptance speed limit. The runtime goal profile retains the unchanged 0.12m/s vector-speed guard. Not a formal N11-N16 profile.
rationale: Only max_velocity_m_s changes from #343's 0.31 to 0.32m/s/axis. #343 measured a final B-spline max |vx|=0.326505m/s while the 0.31m/s configuration's 5%-tolerance gate was 0.3255m/s, causing refusal by 0.001005m/s. At 0.32m/s the same tolerance gate is 0.336m/s, 0.009495m/s above the measured candidate. The value is a planner feasibility allowance derived from one measured curve, not the actual vehicle speed. The existing independent 0.12m/s reference/PX4 vector-speed guard remains active and unchanged; any EGO reference above it cancels the task and enters the existing bridge-owned landing path.
